newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - June 12.

text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in the Japanese press on Thursday, as reported by Kyodo news agency.
-- Manufacturers required to recycle home electronics products under Trade Ministry plan.
-- Denver summit: U.S. wants Japan and Europe to restructure economies.
-- Thirty-seven prefectures adopt measures to prevent spread of O-157 bacteria.
-- Passenger violence on flights of Japan Airlines Co Ltd rises 2.7-fold in year ended March 1997.
-- Tsuneo Uchida, former vice president of Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd, says indirect loans to corporate racketeer reported to then-president Tadashi Okuda.
